source.download_transport: hf-mirror.com; accepted only after matching the SHA256 published on the official Hugging Face file page

selection_rule: Manually stratified by upstream difficulty and algorithm structure before model coding results; stdin tasks with unique integer/string outputs; six distinct contests; not selected using model disagreement or collaboration wins

tasks.focus: 上下界包含关系、首位严格大于其余位
分层状态、最小修改代价的组合
阈值恰好相等、幂级数与早停；不预设协作受益
括号类型、嵌套与错误前缀
简单路径约束、XOR 非单调，避免错误贪心
全局翻转状态、两种代价与大整数

scoring.comparison: exact whitespace-separated output tokens; case-sensitive; no floating-point or multiple-valid-output tasks selected
scoring.public_feedback: original public examples only, equally available to every condition
scoring.final_submission: one complete Python source module; no best-of-message selection
scoring.private_tests: all upstream private tests for each selected task; no subsampling
scoring.execution: macOS sandbox-exec, network denied, home/workspace reads denied, sanitized environment; fail closed if unavailable

next_capability_stage.claim_scope: Exploratory CLI-system coding comparison; no significance or contamination-free claim; no isolated heterogeneous-model causal claim
